subject.title: improve(ios): make gateway QR pairing prominent in Settings

question: Should iOS Gateway Settings permanently use the proposed three-entry-point QR pairing hierarchy and move manual gateway plumbing below pairing and preferences?
rationale: Automated checks can verify wiring but cannot determine whether the navigation button, first-run hero, and Add Gateway row are the intended information hierarchy rather than excessive duplication.

options.title: Approve pairing-first hierarchy
options.body: Keep all three scan affordances and the proposed section order, subject to visual proof and green required checks.

options.title: Narrow the emphasis
options.body: Keep the Add Gateway reorder but retain only one additional prominent scan affordance to reduce duplication.

options.title: Keep current hierarchy
options.body: Reject the broader layout change and limit follow-up to the setup-code busy-state correction.

recommendation.title: Approve pairing-first hierarchy
recommendation.body: Keep all three scan affordances and the proposed section order, subject to visual proof and green required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This is principally an iOS setup-flow and information-hierarchy decision.
